transcript:
Thank you for calling the Emergency Housing Hotline.

If this is a medical, mental health, or life-threatening emergency, please hang up and call 9 1 1 immediately.

This phone line is currently unavailable. Please do not call back and select other menu options in an attempt to reach another department or staff member. Other extensions are unable to assist with Emergency Housing matters. 

If you are calling regarding JCOD Emergency Housing, please listen carefully to the following information:

Hours of Operation and Curfew: The facility's hours of operation are 7AM to 9PM. Clients are expected to return to the facility no later than 9PM. Any necessary accommodations for a late return must be discussed and approved before leaving the facility. If you arrive after 9PM without prior approval, you will not be permitted to enter the facility. You may return at 7AM the following morning.

Case Management or Facility Questions: If you need to speak with your case manager or facility staff regarding your case, services, or other non-emergency concerns, please communicate with staff while you are at the facility. This hotline does not provide case management services.
Complaints and Grievances: If you would like to file a complaint or grievance, please follow the Grievance Policy posted at the facility. Information regarding how to submit a grievance is available on-site.

Referrals and Intake: Emergency Housing does not accept direct or walk-in intakes. Please do not arrive at the facility without an authorized referral. If you are seeking Emergency Housing services, you must contact JCOD and obtain a referral through the appropriate referral process, just as you did when you initially entered the program.
Please do not repeatedly call this number or select other menu options in an attempt to reach another extension. Those departments and phone lines cannot assist with 

Emergency Housing matters, and repeated attempts to bypass the phone system may result in your number being blocked.
Thank you for your patience, understanding, and cooperation.

Hi, and thank you for calling U S S A. If this is a medical, mental health, or life-threatening emergency, please hang up and call  nine one one  immediately. 


If you are calling from two one one Orange County or Los Angeles County, please press 9 now.
If you are a resident at the Emergency Housing Shelter and want to be connected to someone at the front desk, press 4 now.   Please listen carefully as our menu options have changed. Press 1 for housing programs, including sober living, recuperative care, short-term post-housing, and transitional housing. This does not include emergency shelter housing. Press 2 for Molina Housing Navigation and Case Management Services. This option is for people who have already been assigned a housing navigator through Molina. If you are calling about other case management services, not previously listed, please press 3. If you are currently living at the Emergency Housing Shelter and are trying to reach the front desk staff, please press 4. If you are calling to reach someone at 4 1 5, 9 0 6 phone number,  please press 7. To leave a voicemail, press 0.
